mapper.select: select r.workorder_code workorderCode,count(*) reportCount, count(distinct concat(r.xtransfer_no, char(0), r.route_id)) flowcardCount, count(distinct case when r.status=#{fullyStoredStatus} then concat(r.xtransfer_no, char(0), r.route_id) end) fullyStoredFlowcardCount, min(r.create_time) firstReportingTime,max(r.create_time) lastReportingTime from pro_reporting_work r where r.workorder_code in #{code} group by r.workorder_code

select xtransfer_no xtransferNo,route_id routeId,max(route_name) routeName,count(*) reportCount, min(create_time) firstReportingTime,max(create_time) lastReportingTime, max(case when status=#{fullyStoredStatus} then 1 else 0 end) fullyStored from pro_reporting_work where workorder_code=#{workorderCode} group by xtransfer_no,route_id order by xtransfer_no,route_id

select observed.process_id processId,observed.process_code processCode,observed.processName, observed.firstReportingTime,observed.lastReportingTime,latest.record_id lastReportingRecordId, observed.reportCount,observed.reportedQuantity from ( select process_id,process_code,max(process_name) processName, min(create_time) firstReportingTime,max(create_time) lastReportingTime, count(*) reportCount,sum(reporting_work_quantity) reportedQuantity from pro_reporting_work where workorder_code=#{workorderCode} and xtransfer_no=#{xtransferNo} and route_id=#{routeId} group by process_id,process_code ) observed left join ( select process_id,process_code,record_id, row_number() over(partition by process_id,process_code order by create_time desc,record_id desc) rn from pro_reporting_work where workorder_code=#{workorderCode} and xtransfer_no=#{xtransferNo} and route_id=#{routeId} ) latest on latest.process_id <=> observed.process_id and latest.process_code <=> observed.process_code and latest.rn=1 order by observed.firstReportingTime,observed.process_id,observed.process_code
